opportunities.title: Anthropic Academy: Claude courses with official certificates
opportunities.description: Self-paced courses across AI fluency, Claude product training and developer deep dives on the API and Claude Code. Each course ends with a quiz and an official Anthropic certificate.

opportunities.title: GitHub Copilot Fundamentals (Part 1 of 2) learning path
opportunities.description: A nine-module path covering responsible AI, prompt engineering, Copilot Spaces and testing with Copilot. It is the official preparation for the GitHub Copilot (GH-300) certification.

opportunities.title: Introduction to Generative AI (with badge)
opportunities.description: A 45-minute microlearning course explaining generative AI, how it differs from traditional machine learning, and the Google tools for building with it. Completion earns a shareable badge.

opportunities.title: AI Agents Course (fundamentals and completion certificates)
opportunities.description: A hands-on course on building agents with smolagents, LangGraph and LlamaIndex. A fundamentals certificate follows Unit 1, and a full certificate is awarded for a benchmarked final project.

opportunities.title: AWS Skill Builder free digital training
opportunities.description: The free tier includes self-paced courses on cloud and generative AI fundamentals. Check each course page for its digital badge terms before enrolling.

opportunities.title: Deep Learning Institute self-paced courses
opportunities.description: A catalog of self-paced courses on generative AI, LLMs and accelerated computing, several of them free. Select courses award a certificate of competency.

watchlist.title: AI Skills Fest (free certification exam voucher)
watchlist.note: The 2026 edition ran 8–12 June and offered a 100% exam voucher. Watch for the next edition

watchlist.title: Applied Skills credentials
watchlist.note: Lab-based credentials; assessment cost not stated on the official page this week, so verify before booking
